'''Gingerbells''' were a type of plant native to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] loved to eat [[Memily]]'s [[custard bread]] while watching gingerbells bloom.<ref name="hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>
